LESSON: TIME

Grade: SNE  /  physical-impairment / Grade two
Subject: MATHEMATICS ACTIVITIES
Strand: Measurement
Topic 2.4: Time
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 10

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Time, part of Measurement in SNE  /  physical-impairment / Grade two MATHEMATICS ACTIVITIES.

Key inquiry question: How do we tell time?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 2: LEARNING OUTCOMES

By the end of this topic, you should be able to:

Refer to the KICD curriculum reference at the end of this lesson for the full list of outcomes.

SECTION 3: KEY CONCEPTS AND EXPLANATION

A. Suggested learning experiences (from KICD)

1. Discuss share ideas on special occasions that take place in different months of the year, orally (through residual speech)/ by writing/ stamping/ typing on adapted digital devices

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

1. Discuss share ideas on special occasions that take place in different months of the year, orally (through residual speech)/ by writing/ stamping/ typing on adapted digital devices

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Time together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Core Competencies to be developed:
• Citizenship: learner discusses special occasions that take place in different months of the year.

• Self-efficacy: learner reads the calendar in terms of day and date, and measure time using arbitrary units.

Values:
• Patriotism: learner discusses special occasions that take place in different months of the year.

• Integrity: learner discusses the importance of keeping time in different activities.

Pertinent and Contemporary Issues:
(PCIs):

• Global citizenship: learner discusses special occasions that take place in different months of the year.

• Life skills: learners discuss and relates time by hour using the length of a shadow of an object such as a tree in the

environment.

38

Link to other learning areas:

The learner is able to relate the skills of telling time to the concept of weather and sky, and day and night in Environmental

Activities.
